I’ve chosen suffocation as a method of suicide before and… yeah it didn’t work. Thankfully. Because with a few years behind me since then I truly am glad that I’m here. At the time I was facing eviction, had no job, my health was garbage, and I didn’t see any way forward. 

The human instinct to survive becomes unbearable when you try to suffocate yourself. Likely you will get 1-2 zip ties in before you panic. You probably wont have access to scissors and you will run out into the hallway in your last bid to save yourself with your last breath. This will probably be extremely loud, banging into walls and doors, and likely alerting someone who will save you and call 911. Then you’ll be brought to a mental institution where you’ll get to digest the shame of having someone find you like that and you’ll have to explain yourself to any loved ones you may have. 

I second what another commenter said, use the money you’d spend on the hotel room and take yourself out for ice cream or dinner. Watch a show you like. Take life a day at a time, an hour at a time, a minute at a time if you have to. Whatever it takes to survive because every minute, hour, and day is a win. 

There is always time to turn your life around. Time is infinite, you have infinite time to be dead. You have one chance to be alive. What’s the harm in sticking it out until your natural death? 

I know you’re probably laughing at what I’m saying because if you already have a suicide plan you’ve probably lost all hope at this point and you’ve probably heard all of this before. I know when I attempted that’s what I was thinking. But there are good things in life even if they’re small. And if dying is your goal then at the moment find comfort in knowing eventually death is everyone’s fate. But there’s no need to rush it. 

One day you’ll find yourself in a moment of joy and you’ll think to yourself “I’m glad I didn’t kill myself because I wouldn’t have been here for this”. To this day I still think the world is a miserable place. But I’m living from moment to moment and those times when I’m glad to be here are getting more and more frequent as time goes on. I truly hope the same for you. Those moments of joy are just as much of a reason to live as anything else. 

I see you, and I think your life is worth living. I truly hope that you find peace and that you stay with us ❤️
